jobs.description:
About Investment Management

Investment Management strives to deliver exceptional investment portfolios for some of the world’s most influential families and an array of mission-driven institutions. Our goal is to compound returns from diverse sources by harnessing the differentiated capital and strategic strength of the ICONIQ community, cultivated on a foundation of uncommon care.

The Opportunity: Financial Advisory, Analyst

The Financial Advisory Analyst is a critical member of the relationship management team for high net worth and ultra-high net worth clients.

What You'll Do:

- Prepare client balance sheets and develop asset allocation analyses.

- Monitor client investment performance and manage quarterly portfolio reports, ensuring accuracy and consistency.

- Develop a deep understanding of portfolio construction, asset classes, investment products, macroeconomics, client customizations, and professional communication.

- Perform ad hoc analyses for clients’ financial and estate planning needs.

- Participate in equity and option trading activities with increasing responsibilities for investment execution.

- Gather, prepare, and coordinate client tax data and documentation.

- Be exposed to and involved in direct private investments, client interactions, and other critical family office operations.

Ideal Candidate Background:

- 2+ years of relevant professional/financial services experience.

- Passion for investment management and client service.

- Detail-oriented and thorough.

- Superior communication and analytical skills.

- Highly motivated, trustworthy, intellectually curious, and mature.

- Excellent academic background and strong cognitive ability.

- Bachelor’s degree required.

Location: Applicants are expected to work onsite in our New York or San Francisco office in accordance with our hybrid working policy.

- Stipends to support wellness and hybrid working arrangements.

jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
ICONIQ is seeking an Analyst to join our Corporate Finance team, with a focus on the systems, data, and analytical infrastructure that support our financial planning and analysis capabilities. This is an opportunity for someone who combines strong financial and analytical skills with technical curiosity and an interest in building scalable processes and tools. As a member of a small, highly visible team, you’ll help support and expand our enterprise planning platform and related data infrastructure, enabling forecasting, budgeting, management reporting, and strategic analysis. Following our recent migration to Pigment, the team is continuing to modernize how ICONIQ plans, reports, and measures performance.

What You’ll Do

- Support and enhance our enterprise planning platform, including model development, calculations, integrations, data management, user access, and new planning and reporting use cases.

- Build financial reporting, dashboards, models, and analyses that give senior stakeholders greater visibility into resourcing, profitability, cost drivers, and other key business metrics.

- Help manage firmwide time tracking and allocations, maintaining data flows and calculation logic and supporting accurate department- and client-level allocation data.

- Develop and maintain data flows across source systems, our data warehouse, and enterprise planning platform to enable accurate, scalable financial planning and reporting.

- Support monthly and quarterly reporting, forecasting, and annual budgeting by maintaining planning models, coordinating inputs, analyzing results, and preparing materials for senior stakeholders.

- Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, strengthen data quality and controls, streamline workflows, and reduce reliance on offline spreadsheets.

- Explore and apply artificial intelligence and other emerging technologies to improve financial reporting, analysis, and data workflows.

- Partner with colleagues across Investment Management, Human Capital, Operations, Technology, and Accounting to gather requirements, resolve data issues, and deliver high-quality planning and reporting solutions with uncommon care.

Ideal Candidate Background

- 2+ years of relevant experience in financial planning and analysis, financial systems, business intelligence, data analytics, finance transformation, or a similarly analytical role.

- Strong structured problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate underlying business drivers and translate findings into actionable insights.

- Strong Structured Query Language skills and experience working with large, complex data sets.

- Advanced Excel skills, including data manipulation, pivot tables, formulas, charts, and financial modeling.

- Experience with financial planning, reporting, or business intelligence systems; experience with Pigment, Adaptive Planning, Snowflake, Hex, or similar tools is a plus.

- Ability to understand how systems, data, and financial processes connect, coupled with the technical curiosity to quickly learn new platforms and concepts.

- Ability to communicate technical and analytical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate effectively across functions, offices, and time zones.

- Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, accounting, analytics, information systems, or a related field.

- Familiarity with artificial intelligence tools and technologies is a plus; we value people who are curious about using these tools to enhance productivity, streamline workflows, and drive innovation.

As a Senior Analyst or Associate within our Client Development (Business Development) team, you will help identify and develop prospective client relationships, contributing across the business development lifecycle from sourcing and qualification through prospect engagement. You will combine research, analysis, and market intelligence with a commercial mindset to identify opportunities where ICONIQ can add differentiated value.
